name: partambus-perf-tests
description: Tes performa PARTAMBUS dengan k6 (smoke, load, stress). Butuh k6 terpasang: winget install k6 --source winget

scripts.smoke: npm run prepare-dirs && k6 run scenarios/smoke.js
scripts.load: npm run prepare-dirs && k6 run --out web-dashboard=export=reports/load-dashboard.html scenarios/load.js
scripts.race: npm run prepare-dirs && k6 run scenarios/race.js
scripts.stress: npm run prepare-dirs && k6 run --out web-dashboard=export=reports/stress-dashboard.html scenarios/stress.js
